title: Reproduce and identify deferred cancellation heartbeat loss
goal: Create a controlled failing regression and identify event-loop, heartbeat or admission evidence before choosing a causal fix
acceptance: A committed deterministic regression explains the observed worker connection loss
Distinguish fixture timing sensitivity from production behavior
Preserve cancellation replay and fail-closed resource ownership
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures only; no model inference, private hosts or device operations
validation: Independent review before a causal fix closes the parent
escalation: Do not merely widen timeouts or weaken assertions
Keep uncertain external effects held until reconciled

effort.basis: Estimate added at featurePlans adoption (2026-11-11): controlled reproduction of the deferred-cancellation heartbeat loss, then classification; estimate, not a measurement. Baseline 2 days (baselineDays, history), re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0) as 1.25 h = 0.75 h spent to implement (stated) + 0.5 h for review and CI. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h, p90 about 5.1 h); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI. Machine time of CI is not counted. Revised 2026-11-11: run 43084555427 failed the new regression on Windows, so 1.5 h remained. Revised 2026-11-12: the owner agreed 2026-11-11 to continue past the estimate; about 4 h spent (stated: PRs #276, #278, #279, three CI rounds, local diagnosis, time lost to leaked load processes). Revised 2026-11-12 (PR #280): mechanism (3) identified in about 1.25 h more (stated: diagnostics, one CI round, a todo regression, records), about 5.25 h spent; the remedy is an owner decision. About 1 h remains after it (implement the chosen remedy against the todo regression, fresh-context review, repeated Windows and Linux coverage CI). Baseline 1.25 h unchanged.
